title: A hold that cites a page item must name an item that exists and is open
why: A hold on a missing or closed item never lifts, so a lane waits for nothing.
source: Retrospective 14:58 CST Nov 13: the #2889 hold on items 522-525 was copied from triage's step note; no such items exist.
note: Filed 14:58 CST Nov 13. Fault: triage wrote item numbers into a step note (Nov 12) that were never posted; the coordinator and runner 10 copied them. Guard candidate: a check that a hold or note citing a page item finds it on the page, open. The guard that would have stopped it is this step. Triage fix now: the note is rewritten.
